title: Northumberland County Council- FloodAI, using AI to detect flash floods
summary: Northumberland County Council's FloodAI machine-learning service aims to forecast flash floods in six catchments; it was still a prototype in October 2025.
account: In October 2024 the Environment Agency reported that the Northumberland FloodAI project team was applying AI to a network of 43 smart sensors and river gauges and aimed to develop automated flood warnings by 2025. In June 2025 the council reported that the FloodAI research project was developing forecasts for six flash-flood-prone catchments. The council said that the system was at alpha stage and approaching limited piloting. The Environment Agency's national report of 13 August 2025 still described the model as in development and testing. On 24 October 2025 the Northumberland Gazette reported that the warning system was still a prototype. No source documents an issued warning or an avoided flood impact.
